path_policy.caller_rule: Operation parameters containing paths are relative-path enums declared per operation; the caller validator resolves them only under the current T5 run root and rejects absolute paths, traversal, symlink escapes, unknown values, shell metacharacters and type changes.
path_policy.target_rule: Targets are fixed T4 v2 adapter paths with canonical git_blob_id bindings; callers cannot replace a target, interpreter, argv prefix or environment.
path_policy.hash_rule: Tracked targets use canonical git rev-parse HEAD:<path> git_blob_id values; run-local fixture bytes use SHA-256 in probe evidence.

operations.fixed_semantics: Invoke the existing T4 read-only adapter through the registry-fixed /usr/bin/bash interpreter with exactly --watcher WATCHER --tick-marker TICK --max-tick-age-min N; the adapter forwards only those bounded arguments to scripts/graph/dispatch_precheck.sh. Callers cannot choose or change the interpreter, and no command interpolation, cron execution or watcher execution occurs.
forbidden_parameter_forms: any value not exactly equal to a declared relative enum
operations.scope: Only the current run-local fixture watcher and tick receipt input contract; no scheduling, cron, watcher execution or production readiness claim.

operations.fixed_semantics: Invoke the existing T4 adapter through the registry-fixed /usr/bin/bash interpreter with exactly check and one run-local Markdown enum; the adapter invokes scripts/graph/hooks/summary_recompute_guard.py check and forbids --staged. Callers cannot choose or change the interpreter.
operations.scope: Mechanical consistency of one run-local Markdown receipt block and its named JSON artifact only.
unverified: Documents without a receipt block beyond entrypoint semantics

operations.fixed_semantics: Invoke the existing T4 adapter through the registry-fixed /usr/bin/bash interpreter with exactly one matching base Markdown enum. The adapter derives a mismatching Markdown only in a temporary path, calls the unchanged guard check, expects target guard exit code 1, deletes the temporary file and exits 0 only when the negative control is detected. Callers cannot choose or change the interpreter.
operations.scope: Negative-control proof that the unchanged repository guard detects a runtime-only claim mismatch; the wrapper exit code and target guard exit code are reported as distinct fields.
unverified: General detection rate outside this fixture
